signers.label: Approving Judge
signers.note: Filled automatically at approval — not part of the intake handoff flow.

fields.label: Defendant
fields.prompt: What is the defendant's full name?

fields.label: CID
fields.prompt: What is the defendant's CID? Ask them to run /cid in city and share it with you, or answer "Unknown" if you don't have it.

fields.label: Case
fields.prompt: What is the case number for this bail agreement?

fields.label: Amount of Bail
fields.prompt: What is the bail amount? (Minimum $100,000, no maximum -- it should be significant enough to discourage breaking the agreement.)

fields.label: Duration of Bail
fields.prompt: How long is this bail granted for?

fields.label: Bail Conditions
fields.prompt: Are there any conditions attached to this release beyond the standard terms — e.g. restricted areas, no contact with specific people, ankle monitor? List them, or answer "Standard terms only".

fields.label: Defendant Signature
fields.note: Collected from the defendant directly, not the filing officer. Filled via the separate document hand-off/signature-routing system after the filer submits -- not asked during intake.

fields.label: Judiciary Signature
fields.note: Rendered in cursive. Filled in by the bot when a judge accepts the bail on behalf of the Court — never asked of the applicant.
